design_limits: Static mobile candidates use sparse matte vertex colors, not the illustrated fine wood grain, individual leaves or stone texture.
PhotoSurface is one flat material/UV mesh; a runtime replacement material must ignore COLOR_0. Its original amber tree uses no external image or overlay object.
Ground/path/step rectangular beds are closed. Path paver grooves reach the bed at 0.067 m; adjoining tiles have no missing surface.
Gateway width is measured over 0.005–1.60 m height. Its crescent silhouette narrows above that height; the lantern is overhead.
Tree and stone reuse views use rotation and scale of their sole GLB exports.
No browser/WebGL/Safari performance, gameplay integration, coordinator selection or Tom approval is claimed.
runtime_checks: Khronos validator and Three.js CPU loader/geometry/ray checks only. No browser, WebGL, physical Safari or gameplay promotion claimed.
collection_note: The artifact route returns 404 for raw source extensions (.py and .txt). Source files are therefore transferred as independently hashed base64 entries in source-bundle.json, a supported metadata artifact. The collector now writes atomically after verification; no model bytes or cluster configuration changed.
